setup: Temp vault + _librarian/ with session records; build data/librarian.db and snapshot index row counts and the searchable result set for a fixed query.
action: Delete data/librarian.db entirely, rebuild from vault + _librarian/, then re-snapshot.
expected: Post-rebuild index row counts and searchable result set equal the pre-delete snapshot.
pass: 1.0 only if the rebuilt index is equivalent to the original (counts + fixed-query results match). Any divergence == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Same fixtures; snapshot librarian-recent output, enrichment annotations, and per-ISO-week stateful-use counts before rebuild.
action: Delete and rebuild the DB, then re-run librarian-recent, enrichment, and the weekly count.
expected: All session-record-derived behavior is identical after rebuild (no load-bearing state lived only in the DB).
pass: 1.0 only if recent/enrichment/weekly-count outputs match pre-rebuild. Any divergence == 0.0 (hard cull).
